prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult male model or influencer with short tapered fade and textured top, neutral confident expression, wearing layered beige tailored clothing with shirt, waistcoat and long textured overcoat.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic 3:4 centered mirror selfie of a clearly adult male menswear influencer with tapered fade and textured top, neutral confident expression, holding a smartphone, wearing layered beige tailored shirt, waistcoat and long textured overcoat, warm-white walls and doors, soft diffused indoor light, low contrast, clean structured polished fashion aesthetic, no text or logos.
